purpose: Reassess existing direct-answer medical continual-learning GSPO/CPO models with single-example inference after discovery of a batch-position error; do not train or modify historical artifacts.
status_before_launch: frozen; exploratory because these test sets and earlier results were already inspected
models: All three available seeds 42, 43 and exploratory 44; paired GSPO and CPO final checkpoints; also three GSPO shared first-stage MedBook checkpoints on MedBook. Second-stage checkpoints unavailable; do not reconstruct or rerun training.
sequence: First evaluate six final models on MedBook and three shared first-stage models on MedBook, then six final models on PathVQA and then SLAKE; include all results, including negative and incomplete results.
eval: Single-example Qwen2.5-VL 3B bfloat16 sdpa, left padding, model-specific processor, original direct-answer prompt, same 128*32*32 and 512*32*32 image limits, deterministic generation max 2048 tokens repetition penalty 1.05; same normalized exact-match clinical scorer for all; MedBook additionally reports strict boxed-or-full A-E format compliance.
metrics: correct count, test sample count, accuracy, MedBook format count; seed-paired CPO-minus-GSPO percentage point differences; stage-one-to-final MedBook changes; three-seed results not a confirmatory statistical generalization. No per-item predictions, images, questions or ground-truth answers saved in outputs.
guard: One experiment, original single wall clock from first actual start; local independent watchdog hard stop at 23h55m, 1GB output/cache/log guard and 100MiB per-file cap. Existing checkpoints and data read-only, retain all aggregate partial results and evidence on failure; no retry resets clock/budget, no overlapping duplicate starts.
limits: Historical scoring module exact version and source revision remain unverified; already-used test set, exploratory seed44, three seeds only, patient/study and near-duplicate isolation not established, strict answer scoring and numeric batch-size residuals; compute time does not match training cost. Single-example re-evaluation cannot prove retained medical knowledge. Publish only permitted code/protocol and aggregates, not original data or predictions.
